notes: Cumulative percentile cutoffs on the equity ranking in equity.json (0 = best hand, e.g. AA). aggr = where the aggressive region ends; passive = where the passive region ends (both cumulative). Fold takes whatever is left up to 100. Heuristic baselines, not solver output -- see CLAUDE.md for the reasoning and how to retune. push.sb_push and push.bb_vs_push are Nash push/fold approximations for 10bb effective heads-up, not exact solves.
